evidence.claim: POST /api/notes/create enforces 401-then-403 and creates an empty source_type='note' row via insertNote(userId), satisfying AC1 and AC4.
GET /api/notes/list is owner-scoped (WHERE d.user_id = ? AND d.source_type = 'note'), satisfying AC2 and AC4.
PATCH /api/notes/[id] does 401→403→owner+source_type row check via getNoteById(id,userId) (404 if absent), strips '\n---\n' dividers, and enforces the 50K cap returning 413, satisfying AC3 and AC4.

getNoteById scopes ownership AND source_type='note' in WHERE; updateNote's UPDATE WHERE carries id, user_id AND source_type='note' as belt-and-braces guards with correctly ordered parameterized args, satisfying AC5; dynamic SET is built only from fixed internal strings (title/content/updated_at) so no SQL injection vector.
All write paths are additive INSERT of new note rows or source_type/owner-guarded UPDATE; no DELETE and no schema/migration change present, satisfying AC6 and matching DEC-N22 pre-approved scope.
